messages:
Priya: Heads-up — noticed staging override TTL didn't unapply on instance restart; ended up routing ~2% of traffic to canary. Anyone else see this?
Cheng: Saw similar during load test, looked like cache invalidation + reconciler gap.
Alex: Can you paste the console link & sample logs?
Priya: https://console.redwood.ai/configs/override/abc — logs:
```
override_id=abc TTL=300 applied_at=1712349600 node=svc-12
... restart at 1712349661, no removal event
```
Priya: override payload we used:
```
{"override_id":"abc","target":"cohort:beta","changes":{"route":"canary"},"ttl_seconds":300}
```
ops-bot: Created incident INC-623, severity=low, auto-rollback didn't run because failclosed flag=false :warning:
Maya: Quick question — are overrides expected to be durable across process restarts? I thought reconciler would persist and reapply.
Priya: Our reconciler relies on a lease backed by etcd; if the node dies before checkpoint, TTL can expire and the override disappears.
Cheng: Proposal: add optional `durable` boolean on override payload. If durable=true we persist to config-store and reconciler guarantees reapply until explicit removal.
Alex: API change ok but keep backward compatibility — new field optional default false. Need migration doc and SDK bump notes.
Priya: Also need telemetry events: `override.applied`, `override.expired`, `override.reconciled` with tags: durable, source, actor.
Maya: UX: Console should surface a "Non-durable" badge when creating overrides and warn `This override will not survive controller restarts`.
Cheng: I'll prototype: add `durable` flag, reconciler reconciliation window increase, emit metrics `override.reconciled:1` with `durable=true` tag. Will open PR and link here.
Alex: Assign eng-platform, add short RFC (https://redwood.internal/rfcs/352) and update runbook: what to do when cohort coverage changes unexpectedly.
Priya: Thanks — if PR lands today can we do a small canary? Sync at 14:00 if needed :thumbsup:
